Specification: This module specifies a very small state-based initialization test over a single variable s. It defines several helper predicates that constrain s relative to small explicit sets, using quantification, CHOOSE, arithmetic, and a parity helper, and then builds Spec as a disjunction of these initialization-style predicates together with a temporal requirement that always allows only stuttering steps satisfying InitExit on the set {0,1}. The specification does not model faults or a distributed algorithm; instead it appears to be a focused test of initialization predicates and temporal encoding behavior over a single variable.
ChoiceExpr: CHOOSE e \in S: \A a \in S: e <= a
